name: Ape
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 12. Resistant to stunned. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A broad-shouldered ape with long forearms, dark charcoal-brown fur, a gray mantle, and a bare leathery face.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 350. XP is from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +5, DEX +2, CON +2, INT −2, WIS +1, CHA −2. Use the printed modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth.
sections.Traits: Condition resistance. The ape rolls checks and saves to avoid or end the stunned condition with advantage under the v0.2 resistance rule (p. 232).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks. If both hit the same Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). The ape can maintain only one grapple.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 25/50 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Bat
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 11 and Stealth 13. Keensense 60 ft. Vulnerable to deafened and resistant to blinded. No listed languages.
appearance: A tiny brown bat with broad ears, a short muzzle, and thin membranous wings stretched across elongated fingers.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 352. XP is from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −4, DEX +1, CON −1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −3. Use the printed modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth.
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. The bat loses the use of keensense while deafened. Keensense lets it perceive surroundings using a sense other than sight (p. 127).
Heightened Hearing. When perceiving by hearing, use Perception 16.
Condition resistance and vulnerability. Use advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end blinded and disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end deafened (p. 232).
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage on a hit.
